description: This file defines the 'Int' type in the 'types' package, implementing comparison, arithmetic, and conversion methods, as well as constants and protobuf type references, for use within the CEL-Go library.

classes.name: Int
classes.description: A type representing 64-bit integers with methods for arithmetic, comparison, conversion, and JSON safety checks.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds another ref.Val to the Int, returning the result or an error.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares the Int with another ref.Val, supporting Double, Int, and Uint types.

methods.name: ConvertToNative
methods.description: Converts the Int to a native Go type based on the provided reflect.Type.

methods.name: ConvertToType
methods.description: Converts the Int to a specified ref.Type such as Int, Uint, Double, String, Timestamp, or Type.

methods.name: Divide
methods.description: Divides the Int by another ref.Val, returning the quotient or an error.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks equality with another ref.Val, supporting Double, Int, and Uint types.

methods.name: IsZeroValue
methods.description: Returns true if the Int is zero.

methods.name: Modulo
methods.description: Computes the modulo with another ref.Val.

methods.name: Multiply
methods.description: Multiplies the Int with another ref.Val.

methods.name: Subtract
methods.description: Subtracts another ref.Val from the Int.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the ref.Type of the Int.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the underlying value of the Int as any.
